entries.en: Hi!
Thanks for havin' me.
Lookin' good, Joss.
Lookin' good, Joss.
Really think so? Thanks.
Thanks for havin' me over.
entries.en_m: Uh, thanks for havin' me over.

entries.en: How's Randy?
Just helped River out.
It's over now, that's what matters.
What matters is it's over now.
entries.ro: Ce contează e că s-a terminat.

entries.en: It was all River. I just helped.
entries.ro: A fost tot River. Eu doar am ajutat.

entries.en: I just don't know... how to repay you... If Randy had--
entries.ro: Nu știu... cum să-ți răsplătesc... Dacă Randy ar fi--

entries.en: Don't owe me a thing, Joss.
entries.en_m: Uh, don't owe me a thing, Joss.

entries.en: Thank you.
Not comin'?
Not coming?
Spinnin' a new song anyway. Rather focus on that.
entries.ro: Oricum lucrez la o piesă nouă. Mai bine mă concentrez pe asta.

entries.en: Jambalaya. C'mon, you can stir the meat.
entries.ro: Jambalaya. Hai, poți să amesteci carnea.

entries.en: Basmati, nice.
Tomatoes in next...
Now you can toss in the rice.
[Add rice] Rice is in.
Really nice of you to come.
entries.ro: Chiar ai fost drăguță că ai venit.
entries.ro_m: Chiar ai fost drăguț că ai venit.

entries.en: Over here!
No, Randy's always been that way. But I'm sure this didn't help none... You know, his father was a difficult man, too…
entries.ro: Nu, Randy a fost mereu așa. Dar sunt sigură că nici asta n-a ajutat... Știi, tatăl lui a fost și el un om dificil…

entries.en: Oh, hey!
I should be thanking you.
Joss did her bit. Just grab the damn spoon and start stirring.
entries.ro: Joss și-a făcut partea. Ia lingura aia afurisită și începe să amesteci.

entries.en: And when can I visit again?
entries.ro: Și când pot să mai vin?

entries.en: That's great, 'cause I really wanna bring him something. He loves music so... Sorry?
entries.ro: Super, pentru că chiar vreau să-i aduc ceva. Îi place muzica atât de mult... Scuze?

entries.en: No, I'll remember. Just tell me.
Thanks so, so much. You've been wonderful, a huge help. Mhm... Yes, talk again soon.
entries.ro: Mulțumesc din suflet. Ai fost minunată, un ajutor enorm. Mhm... Da, vorbim curând.
entries.ro_m: Mulțumesc din suflet. Ai fost minunat, un ajutor enorm. Mhm... Da, vorbim curând.

entries.en: Glad you're here.  I need your help, cookin'.
entries.ro: Mă bucur că ești aici. Îmi trebuie o mână de ajutor la gătit.

entries.en: What's on the menu?
Dunno... Maybe Joss'd be more help.
entries.ro: Nu știu... Poate Joss ar fi mai de ajutor.

entries.en: This an ancient Ward family secret?
entries.ro: E un secret străvechi al familiei Ward?

entries.en: Uh-huh. Onions, paprika, thyme…
Look strange, different than usual.
entries.ro: Arăți ciudat, altfel decât de obicei.

entries.en: Thought you were joking about cooking together.
entries.ro: M-am gândit că glumeai cu gătitul împreună.

entries.en: Somehow look different than usual today.
Honestly? Thought you were kidding about the cook-off.
entries.ro: Sincer? M-am gândit că glumeai cu concursul de gătit.

entries.en: Yeah… different, meanin' normal. As if you got a good night's sleep.
entries.ro: Da… altfel, adică normal. Parcă ai fi dormit bine.

entries.en: Or that Joss'd sweat away in the kitchen, while…
entries.ro: Sau că Joss ar transpira în bucătărie, în timp ce…

entries.en: You flatline him?
One shot to the head. Quick and clean.
entries.ro: Un glonț în cap. Rapid și curat.

entries.en: He still in a coma?
I wasn't sure that was what I really wanted.
entries.ro: Nu eram sigur că asta chiar voiam.

entries.en: I had the same thought. It would be so easy…
entries.ro: Am avut aceeași idee. Ar fi fost atât de ușor…

entries.en: Yep. In a strange slumber between life and death. An empty shell in a hospital bed.
entries.ro: Da. Într-un somn ciudat între viață și moarte. O coajă goală într-un pat de spital.

entries.en: Not really my jam, picnics. But you have fun.
entries.ro: Nu mi-s fan la picnicuri. Dar distrează-te.

entries.en: Still in the hospital, still in shock. But he's makin' progress.
entries.ro: Tot în spital, tot în șoc. Dar mai progresează ceva.

entries.en: Haven't had the chance to tell you just how grateful I am.
entries.ro: N-am apucat să-ți spun cât de recunoscător sunt.

entries.en: How? Joss doesn't know the first thing about cooking.
entries.ro: Cum? Joss nu se pricepe deloc la gătit.

entries.en: Actually, I like to torture foodstuffs, heh… Haven't had many opportunities lately.
entries.ro: Păi, îmi place să chinui mâncarea, heh… N-am prea avut ocazii pe ultima vreme.

entries.en: Is that so?
Mh. Well, wanted you to see this side of me, too.
entries.ro: Mh. Păi, am vrut să vezi și partea asta din mine.

entries.en: Don't mean to spoil a nice day, but I gotta ask...
entries.ro: Nu vreau să ți-o stric, da' trebuie să întreb...

entries.en: How's Randy holdin' up?
He's looking for his old self.
entries.ro: Încearcă să fie iar el însuși.

entries.en: Physically, though –  it'll be a long road before he's back to full health.
entries.ro: Fizic, în schimb – o să-i ia mult până-și revine complet.

entries.en: And mentally? That was some experience…
entries.en_m: And, uh, mentally? That was some experience…

entries.en: What Harris did to him – fucked as this might sound – might've helped the kid.
entries.ro: Ce i-a făcut Harris – oricât de dement ar suna – poate l-a ajutat pe puști.

entries.en: Could be wrong, but... it feels like a clean break for him.
entries.ro: Poate greșesc, dar... pare o tăietură curată pentru el.

entries.en: What about Peter Pan?
You're asking if I killed him.
We'll talk later, OK?
Sure, no pressure. It's just I... y'know.
entries.en_m: Sure, no pressure. It's just I, uh... y'know.
entries.ro: Sigur, fără presiune. Doar că eu... știi cum e.

entries.en: I know.
All right, I think you've stirred enough.
entries.ro: Bine, cred că ai amestecat destul.

entries.en: Mind grabbing the rice from the kitchen?
Yes, sir.
I paid him a visit at the hospital.
I pressed the gun to his head and…
entries.ro: I-am pus pistolul la cap și…

entries.en: Remembered something…
How my parents died. Sure you want to hear this…?
entries.ro: Cum au murit părinții mei. Sigur vrei să auzi asta…?

entries.en: You know, probably not the best time now?
entries.ro: Știi, poate nu e momentul potrivit acum?

entries.en: Old man had a farm, like Harris' dad. But when business took a turn, well…
entries.ro: Bătrânul avea o fermă, ca tatăl lui Harris. Dar când au mers afacerile prost, păi…

entries.en: My parents managed to open a small grocery. We lived on the floor above.
entries.ro: Părinții mei au reușit să deschidă o alimentară mică. Locuiam chiar deasupra.

entries.en: They wanted cash, register was empty, so they stormed upstairs.
entries.ro: Vroiau bani, casa de marcat era goală, așa că au năvălit sus.

entries.en: Forced us all to kneel and demanded my dad tell 'em where he hid the money.
entries.ro: Ne-au pus pe toți în genunchi și i-au cerut tatei să le spună unde ținea banii.

entries.en: Mostly I remember my mom cryin' while my dad swore they'd found all we had…
entries.ro: Cel mai mult îmi aduc aminte de mama plângând, în timp ce tata jura că au găsit tot ce aveam…

entries.en: River, you don't gotta go on…
entries.ro: River, n-ai de ce să continui…

entries.en: One was skezzed out of his mind. He fired first, blew half my dad's skull off.
entries.ro: Unul era drogat până în măduva oaselor. A tras primul, i-a zburat jumătate din craniu tatălui meu.

entries.en: Heard sob stories enough?
Jesus, River... I'm sorry.
He was erratic, went rabid. Handed me his gun and ordered me to aim it at my mom's head.
entries.ro: Era scos din minți, a luat-o razna. Mi-a dat pistolul și mi-a ordonat să-l țintesc spre capul mamei.

entries.en: I still can see her tear filled eyes at the end of that barrel to this day.
entries.ro: Și până azi îi văd ochii plini de lacrimi la capătul țevii.

entries.en: What'd you do?
Nothin'. I stood frozen.
Finally he just snatched the gun back, shot my mother and they left. Police never caught 'em.
entries.ro: La final i-a smuls pistolul, a împușcat-o pe mama și au plecat. Poliția nu i-a prins niciodată.

entries.en: That was why I joined the force. I couldn't agree with scum like that roaming free, no one to hunt 'em.
entries.ro: De-asta m-am făcut polițist. Nu suportam ca șobolanii ăia să umble liberi, fără ca nimeni să-i vâneze.

entries.en: Can't tell you how sorry I am.
entries.ro: Nu-ți pot spune cât îmi pare de rău.

entries.en: Was Joss there too? Saw all this?
entries.ro: Și Joss era acolo? A văzut tot?

entries.en: So when I stood over Harris in that hospital bed, barrel to his brow…
entries.ro: Așa că, pe când stăteam deasupra lui Harris în patul de spital, cu țeava la tâmplă…

entries.en: Mhm. And I think, when she looks at me, she still sees that boy holdin' a gun to her mom's head.
entries.ro: Mhm. Cred că, uitându-se la mine, vede tot băiatul ăla cu pistolul la capul mamei ei.

entries.en: I was that kid again... But I was also the junkie who shot my parents.
entries.ro: Eram iar copilul ăla... Dar eram și drogatul care și-a împușcat părinții.

entries.en: I understand.
Didn't kill him, then?
I've ended a few lives in my time... but never like that. Never an execution.
entries.ro: Am luat câteva vieți de-a lungul timpului... dar niciodată așa. Niciodată o execuție.

entries.en: I slipped outta the hospital quick, told myself the case was closed.
entries.ro: Am ieșit repede din spital și mi-am zis că dosarul e închis.

entries.en: That's good. But what now? You're not goin' back to the PD?
entries.en_m: That's good. But what now? You're not goin' back to the PD…
entries.ro: Bine. Și acum ce? Nu te mai întorci la poliție?

entries.en: "PI" has a nice ring to it. Who knows – we'll see.
entries.ro: „PI” sună bine. Cine știe, o să vedem.

entries.en: A loud noise woke us one night…
entries.ro: Un zgomot puternic ne-a trezit într-o noapte…

entries.en: River's out back. Y'know, he can't seem to stop gushin' about you.
entries.en_m: River's in the backyard. He couldn't wait to see you again.
entries.ro: River e în spate. Știi, nu mai contenește să vorbească despre tine.
entries.ro_m: River e în curtea din spate. Abia aștepta să te vadă iar.

entries.en: That's exactly what I told 'em. But I always got the same speech back. Nobody cares about these kids who don't exactly fit the mold.
entries.ro: Exact asta le-am zis. Dar mereu primeam același discurs. Nimănui nu-i pasă de copiii ăștia care nu intră deloc în tipar.

entries.en: In those words, yeah. Wanted to tear my hair out every time I heard 'em.
entries.ro: Exact cu vorbele astea, da. Voiam să-mi smulg părul din cap de fiecare dată când le auzeam.

entries.en: Hm, I think it was here…
Umm, rice?
How you doin', Joss?
Um, where'll I find the rice?
I'll call you back later.
Anyway, the rice is… right there.
[Stir] This a family recipe?
How's Randy doin'?
You kill him?
He still in a coma?
You don't have to go on...
Can't tell you how sorry I am.
entries.ro: Nu-ți pot spune cât îmi pare de rău.

entries.en: Joss witnessed all this?
I understand.
Didn't kill him, then?
OK, now this has to bubble and brew. Patio?
entries.ro: OK, acum trebuie să dea în clocot și să fiarbă. Hai pe terasă?

entries.en: Grab a chair… and a beer or something else.
entries.ro: Ia un scaun… și o bere sau altceva.

entries.en: [Sit] This is nice.
It's nice out here.
Uncle River, you said you'd play with us!
entries.ro: Unchiule River, ai spus că te joci cu noi!

entries.en: Yeah. It seems all good, like nothing bad ever happened.
entries.ro: Da. Pare totul în regulă, de parcă n-ar fi fost nimic rău.

entries.en: Sure. No pressure.
Peter Pan – revenge exacted?
How's Randy holdin' up?
How are you?
Um, soymeat? OK.
Gotta keep mixin' if it's not gonna burn.
entries.ro: Trebuie să tot amesteci, că arde.

entries.en: Still stirrin'?
Bet my socks you've never had better jambalaya.
entries.ro: Pun pariu că n-ai mâncat niciodată jambalaya mai bună.

entries.en: Just need to mince some celery and garlic. But you stir, please. Stir.
entries.ro: Trebuie doar să tocăm niște țelină și usturoi. Dar tu amestecă, te rog. Amestecă.

entries.en: I'm stirrin', I'm stirrin'.
Rice is in.
Tell me now? About Harris?
River...?
Hmm. Maybe not just now.
Your parents – what happened?
What… happened?
We were gonna do the nice, relaxing thing. Uh, sounds heavy, this.
entries.ro: Voiam să facem ceva plăcut, relaxant. Ăă, sună greu, asta.

entries.en: OK, yeah. You're probably right.
Just… Harris – what did you do? Had the gun to his head and…?
entries.ro: Doar… Harris – ce-ai făcut? I-ai pus pistolul la cap și…?

entries.en: No, just… this is tough, I can tell. You really don't need to rehash it now.
entries.ro: Nu, doar… e greu, se vede. N-ai de ce să-l reiei acum.

entries.en: You promised!
All right, all right. Let's go. V, join us?
entries.ro: Bine, bine. Hai să mergem. V, vii și tu?

entries.en: [Stand] What are we playing?
What're we gonna play, Uncle River?
You'll see!
Heh. I'm so quick to break down.
Joss wouldn't be more help?
[Stir]
[Wait]
[Stand]
[Drink]
Hey, what's up?
Hey. How's it goin'?
